name: GDELT-tone macro regime gates fear contrarian-long (macro-forced-selling reversion)
rationale: MECHANISM: gdelt_tone measures broad global news mood beyond crypto chatter and is used here as a REGIME GATE, not a trigger. When broad tone is deeply NEGATIVE (macro risk-off) AND crypto fear is extreme, the selling is macro-driven forced liquidation that reverts once the macro scare passes — contrarian-long works. This is the explicit 'contrarian at extremes' leg of the family's two-regime design, switched on ONLY by the slow macro-tone series so we are not applying the contrarian rule in a bull regime where it whipsaws. Entry: gdelt_tone below a fitted negative floor AND fear_greed below a fitted extreme floor. Long; exit on fear relief or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: run this contrarian leg UNGATED vs gdelt_tone-GATED — if the tone gate does not improve OOS DSR over the ungated fear contrarian, gdelt_tone adds no regime information and this is over-engineering; kill. Also: if gdelt_tone is near-constant or laggy at the daily horizon (fires AFTER the turn, not before), it cannot gate in time — verify it moves at regime turns or kill.
catalyst: deeply negative macro tone AND extreme crypto fear (macro forced selling)
